scenarios.minimum_data: cleared source excerpts, claim-level citations, accessibility script
scenarios.stop: uncited historical claim, unresolved rights claim, or inaccessible route

scenarios.minimum_data: asset inventory, licence vocabulary, model and dataset cards
scenarios.stop: copilot gives legal conclusion or source inventory is incomplete

scenarios.minimum_data: de-identified incident material, reviewer decisions, retention clock
scenarios.human_fallback: staffed briefing and printed status notice
scenarios.stop: personal identification, sensational display, or no accountable reviewer

scenarios.minimum_data: synthetic test assets and transformation logs only
scenarios.human_fallback: visible source card stored beside each test asset
scenarios.stop: test touches uncleared media or survival result cannot be reproduced

scenarios.minimum_data: synthetic consent records and parent-child asset graph
scenarios.human_fallback: manual takedown register and staffed confirmation
scenarios.stop: any derivative cannot be located, paused or replaced

scenarios.name_zh: 史实—修复—合成辨识测试
scenarios.minimum_data: cleared or synthetic examples with explicit state labels
scenarios.stop: participants cannot distinguish states or translation changes meaning

scenarios.minimum_data: voluntary recording, scoped consent, transcript corrections
scenarios.stop: unclear consent, sensitive third-party story, or refused correction

scenarios.minimum_data: licensed teaching set; no behavioural ranking
scenarios.human_fallback: mentor-led paper storyboard and citation game
scenarios.stop: mandatory account, minor profiling, or unclear guardian protocol

scenarios.name_zh: 多语字幕与无障碍校样
scenarios.minimum_data: cleared script, translation versions, reviewer sign-off
scenarios.human_fallback: live interpreter and printed bilingual synopsis
scenarios.stop: meaning drift, missing speaker identity, or unreadable presentation

scenarios.minimum_data: seller declaration, material/source note, price and return policy
scenarios.human_fallback: printed label and staffed dispute desk
scenarios.stop: unlicensed work, hidden AI role, or inaccessible circulation

scenarios.minimum_data: supplier declaration, reuse status, maintenance manual
scenarios.human_fallback: engraved durable label and paper maintenance log
scenarios.stop: unknown fire/safety status, no maintenance owner, or false reuse claim

scenarios.minimum_data: opt-in attribution, contribution category, correction and expiry status
scenarios.human_fallback: publicly posted paper proof and staffed correction week
scenarios.stop: ranking people, involuntary naming, unresolved dispute, or stale record
